n_mobilecore_Core_Resume.summary: Resume replaces sockets that iOS may reclaim while the app is suspended. It keeps the existing origin and session slot: an open document can reconnect without navigation, ticket exchange, or any new credential in the proxy. ctx bounds transport construction; only the currently active machine is allowed.
